subject.title: feat(control-ui): import Codex and Claude Code memory

question: Should existing full Codex and Claude migration commands automatically copy newly discovered private memory, or should memory remain an explicit UI/CLI selection?
rationale: The branch changes a shipped command’s data-selection boundary, and source memory is explicitly private; code review cannot determine whether that broader default is the intended product and privacy policy.

options.title: Require explicit memory selection
options.body: Preserve existing CLI defaults and import durable memory only through the reviewed Control UI flow or a new explicit CLI option.

options.title: Approve broader migration default
options.body: Allow full migrations to include memory automatically, with explicit upgrade documentation and tests proving the intended confirmation behavior.

recommendation.title: Require explicit memory selection
recommendation.body: Preserve existing CLI defaults and import durable memory only through the reviewed Control UI flow or a new explicit CLI option.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for the combined product, compatibility, and private-data migration policy.
